'''Badmil''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] merchant who lived on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Badmil was one of many [[Pilgrims]] who settled illegally on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]]. He ran a business in [[Kalikori village]], where he sold a variety of weapons.<ref name="TOR" />
